scope: One CE injection from 5 Hz, with Gaussian noise, rotation, orbital motion, and finite arms.
notes: The eight-sweep run is the main timing result. The six-sweep runs test seed sensitivity.
All CE runs reuse noise seed 1. The seed in config.final.toml is the sampler seed.
Native posterior checks were made on earlier two- and six-sweep runs, not the final eight-sweep posterior.
Exact paired array agreement tests execution, not independent-chain mixing.
Historical configuration and provenance files retain their original external paths and options.

storage_policy.npz: Lossless ZIP compression; index.json records source, archive, and member hashes.

timing.loop: Nested sampling loop, excluding measured compilation.
timing.finalise: Final live-point processing after the loop.
timing.sample_call: Observed call wall time, including first-use compilation.
timing.pipeline: Observed heterodyning start to synchronized sampler return; blank if not measured.
timing.warm_pipeline: Not measured. Loop time alone does not establish event latency.
